transcript.en: Hi Shannon – how are you settling into your new flat?
transcript.zh: 嗨，Shannon-在新公寓住得怎么样？

transcript.en: Really well, thanks.
transcript.zh: 非常好，谢谢。

transcript.en: You look like you're going shopping.
transcript.zh: 你看起来像是要去购物。

transcript.en: Yes, I am. My cousins are coming to stay for a couple of days, and I have to cook for them.
transcript.zh: 是的，我要去。我的表亲要来住几天，我得给他们做饭。

transcript.en: Well, there are plenty of places to buy food in Kite Place – it's the area by the harbour.
transcript.zh: 港口边上的风筝广场有很多地方可以买吃的。

transcript.en: Oh, OK, I'll find that on the map. Thanks.
transcript.zh: 哦，好的，我会在地图上找到的。谢谢。

transcript.en: What sort of food do you need to get?
transcript.zh: 你需要买什么食物？

transcript.en: Well, neither of them eats meat but they both like fish.
transcript.zh: 他们都不吃肉，但都喜欢吃鱼。

transcript.en: Well, there's a really good fish market there.
transcript.zh: 那里有个很不错的鱼市。

transcript.en: Oh great – where is it exactly?
transcript.zh: 太好了，具体在哪儿？

transcript.en: It's at the far end of Kite Place, so you have to go over the bridge and then it's on the right.
transcript.zh: 在风筝广场的最里面，你得过桥，鱼市就在右边。

transcript.en: OK – is it open all day?
transcript.zh: 好的-鱼市全天营业吗？

transcript.en: It doesn't close until four, but I'd recommend going earlier than that – it does run out of some things.
transcript.zh: 4点才关门，但我建议早点去，晚去的话有些东西也许卖完了。

transcript.en: Oh, I don't want that to happen.
transcript.zh: 哦，我可不想那样。

transcript.en: As long as you get there by 3.30, you should be fine. It's only 11 now, so plenty of time.
transcript.zh: 只要你在 3 点半前到，应该没问题。现在才 11 点，时间很充裕。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Do you need to buy vegetables too?
transcript.zh: 你需要买蔬菜吗？

transcript.en: I do, and I want to avoid all the plastic packaging in the supermarket!
transcript.zh: 我需要，而且我想避免超市里用的塑料包装！

transcript.en: Well, there's a really nice organic shop there. Now what's it called . . . it's the name of a flower. I know, it's ‘Rose'.
transcript.zh: 嗯，那里有一家非常不错的有机商店。它叫什么名字？……是一种花的名字，我想起来了，叫“玫瑰”。

transcript.en: That's a nice name.
transcript.zh: 这名字不错。

transcript.en: Yeah – it sells vegetables and quite a lot of other stuff.
transcript.zh: 是的，它卖蔬菜和很多其他东西。

transcript.en: And where's that?
transcript.zh: 这家店在哪儿呢？

transcript.en: Well, as you reach the market, you'll see a big grey building on your left
transcript.zh: 嗯，当你到市场时，你会看到左手边有一幢灰色的大房子-

transcript.en: I think it used to be a warehouse. Anyway, now it's a restaurant upstairs, but the ground floor has two shops either side of the entrance and it's the one on the left—
transcript.zh: 我想它以前是个仓库。总之，现在楼上是一家餐馆，但一层入口两侧各有一家商店，左边那家就是。

transcript.en: That's easy enough.
transcript.zh: 应该很好找。

transcript.en: You can't miss it – there's also a big sign on the pavement so you can look for that.
transcript.zh: 你不会错过的-人行道上也有个大路标，你可以留心一下。

transcript.en: Fine! I guess if I need anything else, I'll have to go to the supermarket.
transcript.zh: 好的！我想如果我还需要什么，就得去超市了。

transcript.en: Yeah – you should be able to get everything you need, but there's a minibus that goes to the supermarket if you need it. It's purple and the number is 289.
transcript.zh: 是的，你应该可以买到所有你需要的东西，但那有一辆迷你巴士可以去超市。车是紫色的，号码是 289。

transcript.en: Thanks, that's great.
transcript.zh: 谢谢，太好了。

transcript.en: So what do you need to get at the fish market? The salmon is always very good and the shellfish.
transcript.zh: 那么你需要在鱼市上买什么呢？鲑鱼和贝类总是很好吃。

transcript.en: I'm going to make a curry, I think, and I need about 12 prawns for that.
transcript.zh: 我打算做咖喱，我想需要 12 只虾。

transcript.en: They'll have plenty of those.
transcript.zh: 鱼市那边有很多。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Have you ever tried samphire?
transcript.zh: 你吃过海蓬子吗？

transcript.en: No – what's that?
transcript.zh: 没有-那是什么？

transcript.en: It's a type of seaweed. I just ask for a handful and you fry it in butter. It's delicious!
transcript.zh: 是一种海草。只要买一把，然后用黄油煎。很好吃的！

transcript.en: Oh, I might try that – how do you spell it?
transcript.zh: 哦，我可以试试-怎么拼？

transcript.en: It's S-A-M-P-H-I-R-E.
transcript.zh: 是 S-A-M-P-H-I-R-E。

transcript.en: Great – it's always good to try something different.
transcript.zh: 太好了-尝试不同的东西总是好的。

transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: I'll see what beans they have in the organic shop and I think I'll get something for dessert there.
transcript.zh: 我应该还会去看看有机商店里有什么豆子，我想我会在那买些做甜点的食材。

transcript.en: How about a mango?
transcript.zh: 芒果怎么样？

transcript.en: I'm not sure – they're not always ripe. I'd prefer a melon – it's bigger too.
transcript.zh: 我不确定-芒果不一定熟。我更倾向甜瓜-它也更大。

transcript.en: Good idea. The owner also sells a lot of spices there that you can put in a curry, and things like coconut.
transcript.zh: 好主意。店主还卖很多可以放进咖喱里的香料，还有椰子之类的东西。

transcript.en: Oh, that's very helpful. I'll have a look.
transcript.zh: 哦，这很有帮助。我会去看看的。

transcript.en: No problem.
transcript.zh: 没问题。

transcript.en: I know bread doesn't really go with curry but I always like to have some in case.
transcript.zh: 我知道面包和咖喱不太搭配，但我总喜欢准备一些以备不时之需。

transcript.en: As I said – all the bread is home-made and there's lots of variety. I like the brown bread myself.
transcript.zh: 如我所说，所有面包都是自制的，种类很多。我自己喜欢黑面包。

transcript.en: Mm, sounds good.
transcript.zh: 嗯，听起来不错。

transcript.en: They sell other things there too.
transcript.zh: 那里还卖其他东西。

transcript.en: Like cakes? I love chocolate cake.
transcript.zh: 比如蛋糕？我喜欢巧克力蛋糕。

transcript.en: Well – not that, but they have a whole range of tarts and the best are the strawberry ones.
transcript.zh: 嗯-不是那个，但他们有各种蛋挞，最好吃的是草莓蛋挞。

transcript.en: Perfect – hopefully I won't even have to go to the supermarket!
transcript.zh: 太好了-顺利的话我都不用去超市了！
